name: Chromatic Agape
source:
Sev (MC), a soon-to-be medical graduate, takes a nostalgic plunge when she comes across her childhood painting. But as she begins working on it once more, she is unexpectedly drawn into the world of her own canvas.

Confronted by multiple pixies, a dastardly “villain,” and six gallant “heroes” who revere their creator as a god-like figure, will Sev be able to discover her creations’ true intentions?

[From [url=https://deniz-g-lerosi.itch.io/chromatic-agape]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
塞夫 (MC) 即将成为一名医学毕业生，当她看到自己童年的画作时，她产生了怀旧的想法。但当她再次开始创作时，她出乎意料地被吸引到了自己画布的世界中。

面对多个小精灵、一个卑鄙的“恶棍”和六位将创造者尊为神明的英勇“英雄”，塞夫能否发现她的创造物的真正意图？
